title: Walmart Shoplifter Goes Berserk After Stealing $1000 Display Item
description:
On September 30th, 2024. Police responded to Walmart regarding a repeat shoplifter, who came back to the store after stealing a high-dollar display item.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

Disclaimer:
